content.short: Saddle Finance is an AMM for stablecoins and wrapped BTC.
content.description: Saddle Finance is a decentralized exchange designed to operate on the Ethereum blockchain, with a clear focus on wrapped assets such as BTC and stablecoins. Users can swap these wrapped assets for stablecoins and also lend or borrow them within the platform. Audits from Certik and OpenZeppelin back the project, pointing to a secure, tamper‑proof, and transparent codebase aimed at enabling reliable, permissionless trading of wrapped assets.
content.meta: Saddle Finance is an AMM for stablecoin and wrapped BTC swaps with low slippage. Discover Saddle Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
